_setup: DEVELOPER / COMPANY ONLY: copy this example to config.json; add only the credentials needed for your role. Never share the populated config.json. Read README.md before administrative commands.
_buyer: For /buy, add your own 32-byte wallet privateKey and matching public address. Leave both blank if you only earn. This wallet signs on Sepolia, Arkiv and Galileo.
_worker: For /earn, add your own worker wallet privateKey and matching address. Use a different wallet from the buyer when using both roles.
_og: For /earn, computeKey is your own 0G sk- inference key; accessKey is an optional mk- balance key. Leave both empty if you only buy.
_funding: Each participating wallet needs Sepolia test ETH for its Dusk name, Arkiv Rabdi GLM for writes, and Galileo 0G for escrow transactions. A buyer also needs enough Galileo 0G to fund jobs.
_public: Public network and contract settings below are shared by users. Restart the app after editing. ENS names are registered on Sepolia; this is testnet infrastructure.
_security: Run only on your own machine. The loopback app loads the requested wallet key and 0G credentials into browser memory; never expose the local server or share config.json.
_operators: Company-authorized operators only. ensOwnerPrivateKey signs namespace and reputation setup. Other operator keys are optional and must only belong to their corresponding on-chain authority. Ordinary users never need this section.
_reputation: Company-only workflow setup. The on-chain revoker is the reputation contract, not workflowOwner. The schedule needs an approved deployed CRE workflow; blank workflowId and forwarderAddress mean automation is not active.
_steps: Copy this example to config.json without overwriting an existing config. Fill your own role credentials, run pnpm install and pnpm dev:web, then choose a name on /buy or /earn. See README.md.
_admin_steps: After configuring the company owner signer, use forge build --root contracts and preview with pnpm ens:deploy or pnpm reputation:deploy. Read the developer setup in README.md before any --yes or --activate operation.
_configuration: Use this example to create a private config.json. Nonblank fields override legacy environment settings; restart the app after changes. .env is optional.
